A pytest unit that fails only through `ERROR path::test_y` setup or teardown lines has no full node IDs.   WHY: A test that passed at the failing SHA is classified `reproduced`, which breaks "A test that passes at the failing SHA is never `reproduced`". The fix from the last run (`test_bare_name_in_pytest_unit_is_unverified`) only works when a `FAILED path::node` line is present. The trigger is narrow, but it fabricates reproduction evidence. Minimal fix: set `bare_ok` False when the tail shows pytest output, about 2 lines.
- Note (ERROR PATHS): The pass-1 claim from google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite (`name.split("::")` AttributeError at line 192) does not reproduce. `if name is not None and names:` at line 188 guards it, and a file-level entry falls through to `return "reproduced", "regression"`, which `test_whole_file_entry_in_failed_unit_is_reproduced` covers.
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. Every deliverable for issue #8474 is in the diff, and wiring the callers is deferred to sibling issues.
